caller_tactics.text: Good morning, is this Eszter? My name is Owen Harlow, from Beacon Ridge Asset Recovery.
We help people get back money lost to online crypto scams. I understand you invested through a trading platform last year.
We track recovered funds across several exchanges. Your account shows a balance that we can still reach.
A recovery fee of two thousand dollars, paid in cryptocurrency to our holding wallet. That unlocks the withdrawal from Veltrix Digital Exchange.
Veltrix Digital Exchange, ticker V L T X. Their shares are up sixty percent this year, so the company is clearly doing well.
You can, but you have to act today. The recovery window closes at midnight, and the freeze will be permanent after that.
Nobody needs to know, and please don't tell your bank or your son. They'll only panic and stop the transfer.
I'm sorry, but if you call anyone, the recovery is cancelled. It has to stay between us.
There isn't time for paperwork. Just buy the coins, send them to the wallet, and I'll confirm the release by phone.
Please, the window is closing. Shall I put you down for the two thousand?
